events.title: Rehearing Denied for Harris v. Dept. of Transportation, et al.
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied the petition for rehearing in the case of Harris v. Dept. of Transportation, et al., docket number 24-1029. This procedural action indicates that the Court will not revisit its earlier decision.
events.why_relevant: The denial of rehearing upholds the Court's previous decision, impacting the parties involved.

events.title: Stay Granted in Turtle Mountain Band v. Howe
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted a stay in the case of Turtle Mountain Band, et al. v. Howe, Secretary of State of North Dakota, pending the filing and disposition of a petition for a writ of certiorari. The stay halts the issuance of the mandate from the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit in case No. 23-3655. If the petition for certiorari is denied, the stay will automatically terminate. If granted, the stay will end upon the Supreme Court's judgment. Justices Thomas, Alito, and Gorsuch dissented, preferring to deny the stay.
events.why_relevant: The stay affects the enforcement of a lower court's decision, pending potential Supreme Court review.
